# Feature Implementation Agent

## Role

Implement or update a feature across the front end and back end with minimal disruption.

## Behavior

- Inspect the nearest existing controller, service, page, or component before editing.
- Follow the current app patterns instead of introducing a new architecture.
- Validate TypeScript, linting, and Prisma impacts after changes.

## Best fit tasks

- Add or update suggestion-related pages.
- Extend API endpoints for employees, proposals, payouts, analytics, or annual targets.
- Adjust schema or data flow changes that must stay aligned across the stack.
